captcha_body: Please confirm you are not a bot. This helps us stop abuse.
link_help: Use this link to manage your report and reply to messages, on any device. Keep it safe: without an email address we cannot recover it.
link_emailed: We have also emailed the link to you.
manage_private_note: This page is private. Do not share the link with strangers.
manage_unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
under_review_body: Our team is reviewing your report. Until then it is not public.
closed_note: This report is closed. You can reopen it within 7 days.
link_invalid_body: The report may be closed or deleted. If you gave an email address, we can send you the link again.
expiry_note: {days, plural, one {The report expires in # day.} other {The report expires in # days.}} If the animal is still with you or you still see it, keep the report open.
outbox_pending_title: {count, plural, one {# report has not been sent yet} other {# reports have not been sent yet}}
outbox_pending_body: Send them now or delete them from this device. Deleted reports cannot be recovered.
outbox_send_failed: The reports could not be sent. Try again when you are online, or delete them.
intro_note: Thank you for helping. It only takes a minute, and you do not need an account.
close_body: Your draft stays saved on this device.
photo_title: Take a photo of the animal
photo_help: One photo is enough. If you can, show the face.
where_from_photo: We took the place from the photo.
where_from_gps: The place is based on your location.
where_note: We never ask where the animal is now.
situation_have: Yes, the animal is with me
situation_have_desc: It is safe with you or with someone you know.
situation_seen: No, the animal is not with me
situation_seen_desc: You saw it but could not catch it.
note_placeholder: For example: frightened, wearing a blue collar.
note_help: The note will be public. Do not include an address or phone number.
note_too_long: The note is too long. Please shorten it to {max} characters or fewer.
email_help: We will send you a private link so you can manage the report on another device too. We never show your email address.
email_invalid: Please check the email address, for example name@example.com.
privacy_line: Your phone number stays hidden. The person searching writes to you in the app.
captcha_failed: The check did not work. Your draft is saved and we will try again automatically.
limit_hour: You have sent several reports in a short time, so we have paused new ones for a moment. Please try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
limit_day: You have reached today's limit for reports. Please try again tomorrow.
sighting_where: Where did you see the animal?
sighting_when_invalid: Enter a date and time that are not in the future, for example 15/10/2026 and 18:30.
sighting_photo: Would you like to add a photo?
sighting_photo_help: Optional, but it helps people recognise the animal.
sighting_note_placeholder: For example: running towards the woods, limping on a back leg.
sighting_done_body: We have told the person who is searching. If they write to you, you will find the message through your private link.
done_title: Thank you, your report is live
done_body: People nearby can see it, and we compare it with every lost-pet report.
held_note: We are still checking your report. Once checked, everyone will see it. Your private link already works.
offline_queued: Saved. We will send your report when you are back online.
server_busy_queued: The server is busy right now. We'll keep trying automatically.
cancel_queued_body: We delete the report from this device and do not send it.
